description:
Relay a tools/call to a registered MCP service and notarize the
    exchange: request hash + response hash + outcome land in a tamper-evident
    receipt chain. Idempotent on call_id (a replay returns the original
    receipt and cached result — the downstream is never double-called).
    Failures are receipted evidence, not silence.

arguments.description: Optional. Arguments for the tool, as an object.
arguments.title: Arguments

call_id.description: Your id for this call; repeating it returns the original receipt.
call_id.title: Call Id

payment_ref.description: Optional. A paid credit or payment reference, used only after the free daily calls. Leave it out to use the free tier or a seat.
payment_ref.title: Payment Ref

request_id.description: Optional. Your id for this call. Repeat it to retry safely: the same request_id is never charged twice.
request_id.title: Request Id

service_id.description: The service id returned by register_service.
service_id.title: Service Id

timeout_s.description: Optional. Seconds to wait for the service. Default 20.
timeout_s.title: Timeout S

tool.description: Name of the tool to call on that service.
tool.title: Tool

name: call_verified
title: Call verified
